app-templates.message:
fix(interactive): the browser tests press ä, ö, ü and ß too

## Intent

The browser tests of an interactive app could not press ä, ö, ü or ß, because Playwright knows only the keys of a US keyboard by name. In the eval run of 2026-10-21, all three Haiku trials rewrote their playthroughs so that they never press such a key, and the check stayed red where they did.

## Key changes

- A key that Playwright does not know by name goes to the page as a keydown event with that key, which the runtime listens to.
- The example checks ü as a wrong key.

## Dependencies and side effects

- lernapps/tooling 4258ef4 records the run that found the bug.

feat(evals): the small run of 2026-10-21, phase announced (interactive × Haiku × 3)

## Intent

The phase announcement and the creator's end marker had not been measured yet. A small run with Haiku on the interactive archetype should show whether they work, and whether Haiku now gets from Code to Commit.

## Key changes

- The score reads the phase from the first text of a reply and compares it with the plan's phase after the tool calls before it. It leaves out the reply to the creator's last message, which no one reads.
- The personas send their last message with the end marker on its last line, instead of writing the marker only into their own summary.
- The run's results and conclusions: Haiku passes the check in 3 of 3 trials, creates nothing before the plan, and sets phase: commit before the GitHub question in 2 of 3; two trials begin every reply with the phase.

## Dependencies and side effects

- lernapps/app-templates 0cb0631 fixes the browser tests that could not press ä, ö, ü and ß, which the green checks of this run had hidden.
